_help: One entry per project. rom.names: word lists that must all appear in a file name. rom.sha1 / rom.crc32: checksums of dumps the project accepts (python -m distill.recomps hash <file> prints them); with them, a match is 'verified'. asset / exe: optional regexes when the automatic pick of the release file or executable is wrong. Put your own additions in distill_recomps_catalog.json beside the app (same format; the same id replaces an entry).

recomps.name: Ship of Harkinian
recomps.game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
recomps.description: A native PC port of Ocarina of Time built from the decompiled game, with widescreen, higher resolutions, controller remapping and a mod and randomizer scene.
recomps.setup: On first launch it asks for your own Ocarina of Time ROM and builds its asset file from it.

recomps.name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian
recomps.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
recomps.description: The Ship of Harkinian team's native PC port of Majora's Mask, with the same enhancements and a mod loader.
recomps.setup: On first launch it asks for your own Majora's Mask ROM and builds its asset file from it.

recomps.name: Zelda 64: Recompiled
recomps.game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
recomps.description: Majora's Mask statically recompiled to run natively on PC, with ray-traced-era graphics options, gyro aiming and mod support.
recomps.setup: On first launch it asks for your own Majora's Mask ROM (the US version).

recomps.name: Dusklight
recomps.game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
recomps.description: A reverse-engineered reimplementation of Twilight Princess that runs natively on PC, as accurate as possible to the original while adding options, enhancements and tools.
recomps.setup: Needs your own copy of Twilight Princess; follow the project's first-run prompts to point it at your dump.

recomps.setup: Its installer asks for your own game files; follow its prompts.
